description: The page's own: copy the compose file's local config folder (engine.workers.configuration, fs adapter, from the person's folder) into the selected environment's console config in iii cloud, one entry per container. dry_run previews it and writes nothing; applying needs the dry run's version as expected_version. Secret-looking keys and values are left out, by name. Agents never call it.

environment_id.description: The selected environment, as a guard (`ENVIRONMENT_CHANGED`).

expected_version.description: The `version` the dry run returned. Needed to apply.

fields.description: The fields copied, as dotted keys; lists stay JSON values. `value` is null once applied.

file.description: The file, from the repository root.

left_out.description: Secret-looking keys or credential-looking values, by key only.

set_elsewhere.description: Keys iii cloud or the compose file set, which the console can't change.

worker.description: The container key iii cloud keeps the config by.

oneOf.description: No container iii cloud runs has that config entry.
A link, or outside the repository.

response_schema.description: What `iii-cloud::config::import` copies. Values only in a dry run's preview, never a secret-looking one: no `Debug`, so they never reach a log.

directory.description: The config folder, from the repository root (`api/config`).

draft_changed.description: iii cloud has unapplied console edits for this environment: applying is refused until they're applied or dropped there.

skipped.description: Files of the folder not copied, and why.

version.description: The config version the dry run read, or the one the apply made.

response_schema.title: ConfigImported
